Later unchanged() revalidates clearance/scientific inputs and self source, but not accepted historical/current evidence. Provenance hashes are reread from archive after the calls; current receipts are replaced without rechecking their accepted bytes. Current original stage/publish intents are not compared with archived originals at all.
